rating_up.text: Sharper on the ball this month.
Training like a man who wants a shirt.
Best week he's had in a while.

rating_down.text: Struggling with the pace of training.
His head isn't fully here this week.

growth.text: Making real progress. You can see it.
The focus work is paying off.

condition_low.text: Running on empty. Needs a lighter week.

workload_heavy.text: The extra sessions are starting to show.

young.text: Raw, but the talent is obvious.
Mentoring is helping. Calmer on the ball.

veteran.text: Knows his body. Trust him on rest days.
Leads the warm-up without being asked.
